2942-two-penniless-princesses.title: Two Penniless Princesses
2942-two-penniless-princesses.creator: Charlotte M. Yonge
2942-two-penniless-princesses.description: A book by Charlotte M. Yonge. with eyes of the same tint as the hair. Even the sea-breeze failed to give more than a slight touch of colour to her somewhat freckled complexion; and the limbs that rested in a careless attitude on the stone bench were long and languid, though with years and favourable circumstances there might be a development of beauty and dignity.

arxiv-2012-04780.title: Open Knowledge Graphs Canonicalization using Variational Autoencoders
arxiv-2012-04780.creator: Sarthak Dash, Gaetano Rossiello, Sugato Bagchi
arxiv-2012-04780.description: Abstract Noun phrases and Relation phrases in open knowledge graphs are not canonicalized, leading to an explosion of redundant and ambiguous subject-relation-object triples. Existing approaches to solve this problem take a two-step approach. First, they generate embedding representations for both noun and relation phrases, then a clustering algorithm is used to group them using the embeddings as features.

arxiv-2207-09668.title: Convergence Results of Two-Step Inertial Proximal Point Algorithm
arxiv-2207-09668.creator: Olaniyi S. Iyiola, Yekini Shehu
arxiv-2207-09668.description: Abstract This paper proposes a two-point inertial proximal point algorithm to find zero of maximal monotone operators in Hilbert spaces. We obtain weak convergence results and non-asymptotic O ⁡ ( 1 / n ) O(1/n) convergence rate of our proposed algorithm in non-ergodic sense.

arxiv-2211-00565.title: REVISITING HETEROPHILY IN GRAPH CONVOLUTIONAL NETWORKS BY LEARNING REPRESENTATIONS ACROSS TOPOLOGICAL AND FEATURE SPACES
arxiv-2211-00565.creator: Ashish Tiwari, Sresth Tosniwal, Shanmuganathan Raman
arxiv-2211-00565.description: Abstract Graph convolution networks (GCNs) have been enormously successful in learning representations over several graph-based machine learning tasks. Specific to learning rich node representations, most of the methods have solely relied on the homophily assumption and have shown limited performance on the heterophilous graphs.

arxiv-2212-11731.title: Stability for Φ S , F , H \Phi_{S,F,H} harmonic map and Φ T , F , H \Phi_{T,F,H} harmonic map
arxiv-2212-11731.creator: Xiangzhi Cao
arxiv-2212-11731.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiangzhi Cao. In this paper, we mainly consider the stability of Φ S , F , H \Phi_{S,F,H} harmonic map and Φ T , F , H \Phi_{T,F,H} harmonic map from or into Φ \Phi -SSU manifold. We mainly consider the stability of Φ S , F , H \Phi_{S,F,H} harmonic map and Φ T , F , H \Phi_{T,F,H} harmonic map from or into compact convex hypersurface.

arxiv-2403-00401.title: Enhancing Biomechanical Simulations Based on A Posteriori Error Estimates: The Potential of Dual Weighted Residual-Driven Adaptive Mesh Refinement Institute of Computational Engineering, Department of Engineering, Luxembourg, stephane.bordas@gmail.com TwInsight, Grenoble, France, marek.bucki.pro@gma
arxiv-2403-00401.creator: Huu Phuoc Bui, Michel Duprez, Pierre-Yves Rohan, Arnaud Lejeune
arxiv-2403-00401.description: Abstract The Finite Element Method (FEM) is a well-established procedure for computing approximate solutions to deterministic engineering problems described by partial differential equations. FEM produces discrete approximations of the solution with a discretisation error that can be an be quantified with a posteriori error estimates.

arxiv-2504-16347.title: An efficient offline sensor placement method for flow estimation Journal: Experimental Thermal and Fluid Science
arxiv-2504-16347.creator: Junwei Chen, Marco Raiola, Stefano Discetti
arxiv-2504-16347.description: Abstract We present an efficient method to optimize sensor placement for flow estimation using sensors with time-delay embedding in advection-dominated flows. Our solution allows identifying promising candidates for sensor positions using solely preliminary flow field measurements with non-time-resolved PIV ( PIV ), without introducing physical probes in the flow.

arxiv-2505-23092.title: L’Hôpital’s Rule is Equivalent to the Least Upper Bound Property Thanks: This material is based upon work supported by the National Science Foundation under Award No. 2400329
arxiv-2505-23092.creator: Martin Grant, Kyle Hambrook, Alex Rusterholtz
arxiv-2505-23092.description: Abstract . We prove that, in an arbitrary ordered field, L’Hôpital’s Rule is true if and only if the Least Upper Bound Property is true. We do the same for Taylor’s Theorem with Peano Remainder, and for one other property sometimes given as a corollary of L’Hôpital’s Rule. 1.

arxiv-2506-04258.title: Differential measurement of m e / m p m_{\rm e}/m_{\rm p} : 3 mm methanol lines toward Sagittarius B2(N) and (M) molecular clouds
arxiv-2506-04258.creator: J. S. Vorotyntseva 1, S. A. Levshakov 1, C. Henkel 2
arxiv-2506-04258.description: Abstract Differential measurement of the fundamental physical constant μ = m e / m p \mu=m_{\rm e}/m_{\rm p} (the electron-to-proton mass ratio) toward two sources located near the Galactic center – the Sagittarius (Sgr) B2(N) and (M) molecular clouds – show a lower μ \mu compared to its terrestrial value.

braid-magic-witchcraft-animal-magnetism-.title: Magic, Witchcraft, Animal Magnetism, Hypnotism, and Electro-Biology
braid-magic-witchcraft-animal-magnetism-.creator: James Braid
braid-magic-witchcraft-animal-magnetism-.description: Braid's mature synthesis (3rd edition, greatly enlarged, 1852): witchcraft, demonic possession, and mesmeric marvels re-read as misapprehended nervous and psychological phenomena. The capstone of his demystification project.

catholic-encyclopedia-1913-domingo-banez.creator: John Volz
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-domingo-banez.description: Article 'Domingo Banez' from the Catholic Encyclopedia (1913), the 15-volume English-language reference work published 1907-1914 by Robert Appleton Company.

pmc-10653383.title: Adaptive sampling for nanopore direct RNA-sequencing
pmc-10653383.creator: Isabel S Naarmann-de Vries, Enio Gjerga, Catharina LA Gandor, Christoph Dieterich
pmc-10653383.description: Nanopore long-read sequencing enables real-time monitoring and controlling of individual nanopores. This allows us to enrich or deplete specific sequences in DNA sequencing in a process called “adaptive sampling.” So far, adaptive sampling (AS) was not applicable to the direct sequencing of RNA.

pmc-11304961.title: Delayed presentation of traumatic cervical epidural hematoma: a case report and review of the pertinent literature
pmc-11304961.creator: Taiki Isaji, Tadato Yukiue, Takayuki Amano
pmc-11304961.description: A delayed presentation of traumatic spinal epidural hematoma (SEH) is a rare disease in which most patients are asymptomatic for days to weeks after the injury, followed by pain and then a neurological deficit. A 66-year-old woman who suffered a fractured right clavicle due to a bicycle accident 42 days previously, presented with left shoulder pain and left hemiplegia.

pmc-11550012.title: Rapidly growing knowledge of Mycobacterium smegmatis: A case series and review of antimicrobial susceptibility patterns
pmc-11550012.creator: Patrick D Crowley, James J Vaillant, Joshua D Shirley, Nancy L Wengenack, Mary Jo Kasten
pmc-11550012.description: Mycobacterium smegmatis is a rapidly growing nontuberculous mycobacterium that is rarely isolated from clinical specimens and is frequently considered to be a contaminant. We conducted a retrospective review of mycobacterial cultures positive for M. smegmatis from 1998 to 2023 at our institution to evaluate the clinical significance of recovering this mycobacterium. Antimicrobial susceptibility patterns were also determined. Twenty-two M.

pmc-11640980.title: Physician Deserts: Navigating the Texas Terrain of Provider Supply and Demand with GIS Mapping
pmc-11640980.creator: Syed Hussain Jafri, Subi Gandhi, Edward Osei
pmc-11640980.description: Background: Rural health disparities in Texas impact population health due to limited healthcare access, insurance, and transportation challenges, especially in medically underserved areas. A shortage of specialists in rural regions worsens these issues, leading to increased morbidity and mortality rates.

pmc-11657737.title: Epigenetic regulation on left atrial function and disease recurrence after catheter ablation in atrial fibrillation
pmc-11657737.creator: Mi-Ryung Han, Joo Hee Jeong, Yun Gi Kim, Hyun-Ho Yang, Chang-Ok Seo, Yeji Kim, Hyoung Seok Lee, Jaemin Shim, Young-Hoon Kim, Jong-Il Choi
pmc-11657737.description: BackgroundGenetic variation and modifiable risk factors play a significant role in the pathogenesis of atrial fibrillation (AF). The influence of epigenetic modification on AF remains to be elucidated. We investigated the role of DNA methylation in the etiology of AF. Epigenetic evaluation was performed in 115 AF patients who underwent radiofrequency catheter ablation in a single institution.

pmc-12438487.title: Assessment and Management of PTSD Among Children and Adolescents with ADHD as a Preventive Strategy for Suicidal Behaviours
pmc-12438487.creator: H. Kerbage
pmc-12438487.description: Children and adolescents with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) are at an increased risk of experiencing traumatic events and developing Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD). The interplay between ADHD and PTSD presents unique diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, as symptoms such as emotional dysregulation, impulsivity, and attentional difficulties may overlap, complicating early identification and intervention.

pmc-12649760.title: From Compensation to Collapse: UVB-Driven Disruption of Host–Microbiota Homeostasis Exacerbates Amphibian Ecological Risk
pmc-12649760.creator: Zi’ao Yuan, Jirui Fei, Siqi Li, Yueluan Wu, Peng Liu
pmc-12649760.description: Simple SummaryAmphibians face severe threats from increasing ultraviolet-B (UVB) radiation due to ozone depletion and climate change. Using Xenopus laevis as a model, this study investigated the effects of varying UVB doses on multi-organ health and symbiotic microbiota. We found that low-dose UVB activated protective responses, including elevated antioxidant enzyme activities and proliferation of anti-inflammatory bacteria.

pmc-12741107.title: Monitoring OTC drug sales for early detection of respiratory infectious disease outbreaks
pmc-12741107.creator: Junjie Li, Chen Wu, Kui Liu, Qinbao Lu, Xinyi Wang, Zheyuan Ding, Tianying Fu, Xuefeng Jiang, Haocheng Wu
pmc-12741107.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundIn recent years, over-the-counter (OTC) drug sales have emerged as a novel indicator for symptom monitoring, attracting widespread attention in public health research globally. This study conducted weekly monitoring of five OTC drug categories related to fever respiratory system diagnostic cluster (FRSDC) — antitussive/expectorant drugs, cold medications, antibiotics, pungent and cool exterior-relieving agents, and influenza medicine — in Pinghu City, Zhejiang Province, from 2022 to 2024.

pmc-12984458.title: Distinct NK Cell Signatures Define Prognosis in HPV-Positive Versus HPV-Negative Head and Neck Cancer
pmc-12984458.creator: Rui Li, Fangjia Tong, Huan Liu, Zengchen Liu, Wanlin Li, Yingdong Zhang, Yiman Peng, Shuang Pan, Lanlan Wei, Ning Li, Ming Chu
pmc-12984458.description: Simple SummaryHead and neck cancer can be caused by human papillomavirus (HPV) infection or by factors such as smoking. Surprisingly, patients with HPV-positive tumors tend to have better outcomes than those with HPV-negative ones, but the immune-related reasons for this difference remain unclear.

pmc-13071867.title: A Single‐Chain Light‐Activatable Transcriptional Reporter for Fluorescently Tagging Mammalian Cells In Vitro
pmc-13071867.creator: Ola Bartolik, Wenjing Wang
pmc-13071867.description: Optogenetic tools have revolutionized the control of gene expression with high spatial and temporal resolution. Here we present a Single‐chain Light‐Activatable Transcriptional Reporter (SLATR), a system capable of fluorescently tagging target cells with minutes of white light stimulation. In its inactive, or dark state, a transcriptional factor is cytosolically bound, preventing nuclear translocation.

pmc-13085495.title: Phthalates as the silent saboteurs of male fertility via changes in semen quality: a systematic review
pmc-13085495.creator: Swati Dhar, Akash Tomar, Anupama N, Poulomi Chatterjee, Pratik Kumar Chatterjee
pmc-13085495.description: BackgroundPhthalates, which are commonly used as plasticizers, are pervasive in modern environments. The potential effects of endocrine-disrupting chemicals (EDCs) on human reproductive health have raised concerns. Among the various health risks, a significant focus has been on male fertility, particularly the relationship between phthalate exposure and a reduced sperm count.

pmc-13210815.title: BATFNet: Boundary-Aware Transformer Fusion Network for RGB-DSM Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
pmc-13210815.creator: Yilin Tong, Meng Tang, Yu Zhang, Yan Huang, Jing Huang, Yuelin He, Yuxin Liu, Edore Akpokodje, Dan Zheng
pmc-13210815.description: Semantic segmentation of very-high-resolution remote sensing imagery benefits from combining RGB appearance with Digital Surface Model (DSM) height information, especially in urban scenes where spectrally similar objects often differ in elevation. On the ISPRS Vaihingen and Potsdam benchmarks, BATFNet achieves mIoU scores of 84.06% and 85.31%, respectively, outperforming representative RGB–DSM fusion baselines on most land-cover categories.

pmc-13373778.title: Correction: GNPAT promotes immunosuppression in hepatocellular carcinoma by activating the plasmalogen-PPARg pathway to drive M2 macrophage polarization
pmc-13373778.creator: Meng Hu, Nan Zhang, Ya-Qi Wang, Xiao-Ming Wang, Yun Shi, Min Yao, Lian-Guo Hou, Ling-Ling Jiang
pmc-13373778.description: erations and lipidomic reprogramming in HCC. (A) Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images of peroxisomes (indicated by arrows) in adjacent and tumor tissues. pmc-13374164.title: Impact of multimodal AI literacy, critical thinking, and resilience on academic performance in early childhood education: a multiple chain mediation analysis of multimodal AI self-efficacy and cognitive engagement
pmc-13374164.creator: Wu Lei, Kamariah Abu Bakar, Khairul Farhah Khairuddin, Juan Du
pmc-13374164.description: IntroductionWith the continuous integration of multimodal artificial intelligence (AI) into higher education, students majoring in Early Childhood Education (ECE) are expected not only to master the operational use of multimodal AI tools but also to develop the ability to evaluate, reflect on, and adapt to intelligent learning environments.

pmc-13591149.title: Medical imaging in immunotherapy response evaluation: from RECIST to AI-driven longitudinal models, and the distinction between risk prediction and kinetic diagnosis
pmc-13591149.creator: Huzhe Cui, Zhengri Piao, Songnan Zhang
pmc-13591149.description: Immune checkpoint inhibitors have reshaped cancer treatment, but the response patterns they produce—pseudoprogression, dissociated responses, and hyperprogressive disease (HPD)—fit awkwardly into the size-based logic of RECIST 1.1. This narrative review, prepared with reference to the SANRA criteria, follows the evolution of response assessment from RECIST 1.
